items: India's Himalayan region falls within the highly vulnerable Mid-Continental seismic belt.
Deep-focus earthquakes occur almost exclusively along subduction zones within the Circum-Pacific Belt.
Divergent plate boundaries, such as the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, are characterized strictly by shallow-focus earthquakes.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Circum-Pacific Belt, popularly known as the Pacific Ring of Fire, accounts for nearly 68% of the world's total seismic activity.
The Mid-Continental Belt extends along the Alpine-Himalayan mountain chain, covering Southern Europe, North Africa, and Northern India.
The Mid-Atlantic Ridge experiences shallow-focus earthquakes along ocean floor spreading ridges at divergent boundaries.
Earthquake distribution closely outlines the active margins of lithospheric plates, including subduction zones and rift valleys.
